4.5 Service Discovery Control for SWCs
[SRS_ModeMgm_09281]{DRAFT} ⌈ Description: Service Discovery shall be controllable by a standardized interface towards Application SWCs both on server and client side. Rationale: Lower complexity by providing a standardized interface instead of designing this interaction every time in a project specific way.
▽
△
Use Case: A server SWC wants to indicate the availability of the events it produces, a client SWC wants to indicate the need for events, Client or Server SWCs want to get informed about subscriptions/subscribers. Dependencies:
